question.text: Which of the following statement is correct with refrence to <math><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Θ</mi></mrow></msup></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Θ</mi></mrow></msup></math> . ?

options.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Θ</mi></mrow></msup></math>  is less basic and less nucleophilic than  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Θ</mi></mrow></msup></math>

<math><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Θ</mi></mrow></msup></math>  is less basic but more nucleophilic than  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Θ</mi></mrow></msup></math>

<math><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Θ</mi></mrow></msup></math>  is less basic and more nucleophilic than  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Θ</mi></mrow></msup></math>

<math><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Θ</mi></mrow></msup></math>  is more basic but less nucleophilic than  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Θ</mi></mrow></msup></math>

solution.text:
Nucleophilic strength increases down a column of the Periodic Table (in solvents

that can have hydrogen bonds, such as water, alcohols, thio alcohols).

Nucleophilic strength ROΘ<RSΘ . Base strength ROΘ>RSΘ . Thus, RSΘ is more nucleophilic but less basic than ROΘ
